transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support, my name is Chloe. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Chloe, my name is Valerie Wood. We have an S-Net TV 4K box, and for the past three days the automated audio description voice synthesizer has been permanently stuck on across every single channel, narrating every actor movement over movie dialogue even though Audio Description is toggled 'Off' in our settings!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Valerie. If I understand correctly, your TV 4K box has its audio description voice narration permanently stuck on across all live and on-demand channels, continuing to narrate programs even with the accessibility toggle switched to off in your user settings. Before we query your set-top box accessibility profile, could you please confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Queensgate, Inverness, IV1 1DF, security PIN 3381, TV box serial SN-TV-881902.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Valerie, that confirms your account details. Have you tried power cycling the TV box at the mains wall socket?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I switched it off at the wall for ten minutes last night, but as soon as BBC One loaded, the narration voice started describing the news anchor's clothes immediately!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your set-top box firmware accessibility state tables and audio PID stream decoders?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Valerie. Looking at the audio decoder registers, your box firmware has a persistent secondary audio program stream lock on the NAR audio PID.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would a secondary audio program stream lock onto the narration PID?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When an over-the-air firmware patch updates the Dolby Digital audio driver, the default audio stream index occasionally fails to clear the broadcast narrative flag.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you clear the secondary audio stream lock remotely?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we can transmit an immediate audio PID re-initialization command directly to your TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will that reset our recorded shows or channel favorites?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all: recorded programs, scheduled timers, and channel favorites remain completely intact; only the live audio stream multiplexer is re-initialized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is brilliant news.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Valerie speaking, I am hosting our village film club tonight at six o'clock to watch a subtitled French classic drama that we have planned for six months! If a mechanical robotic voice keeps narrating every single camera angle and cough over the delicate French dialogue, the entire screening will be completely ruined and all my neighbors will be irritated! I am so stressed and embarrassed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am querying your set-top box audio stream decoders right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do Chloe, I am desperate to avoid embarrassing our guests.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how stressful and embarrassing this is, Valerie, especially with your village film club arriving tonight for a screening you have planned for six months. While our engineering policy does not permit dispatching an emergency field technician to your home within two hours, I will make sure this audio stream is completely fixed and verified live on call right now so your evening is a complete success.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Chloe, that is such a relief to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am sending the audio multiplexer reset payload to your TV box now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously broadcast multiplex streams carry separate narrative and stereo audio PIDs that require clean decoder allocation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The TV screen flashed black for two seconds and returned to BBC One.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Valerie speaking, our film club chairman is eighty-four years old and has very sensitive hearing aids! Last week when a loud automated voice boomed through the speakers unexpectedly, his hearing aids shrieked with high-pitched feedback and he had to leave the room in severe pain! If that happens in my home tonight, I would never forgive myself! I am terrified of hurting his ears!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your deep concern and protective care for your eighty-four-year-old film club chairman and his sensitive hearing aids, Valerie. Preventing any harsh feedback or unexpected narration is an absolute priority. Let us unmute your TV right now, switch through multiple channels together, and confirm that only pristine, clean stereo dialogue is broadcasting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Unmuting the television on BBC One now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Listen carefully to the live broadcast: do you hear any narrative voice describing the presenters?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The news presenters are speaking... Chloe! Only their natural voices are coming through! Zero narration! Zero robotic audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! Now let us switch to Channel 4 and test a drama with heavy audio description.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Changing to Channel 4... A drama is playing... The actors are whispering... No narration voice at all! Pristine audio!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us test your on-demand player or a saved French film recording to be one hundred percent certain.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Loading the French film from our library... Playing... Chloe, the French dialogue and original soundtrack are playing in crystal-clear high definition with zero background voice! It works flawlessly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full audio PID allocation restored and secondary narrative stream permanently deactivated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your film club chairman will be able to enjoy the screening in complete comfort tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have locked the audio stream decoder configuration in your hub profile to prevent any recurrence.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will protect us from future firmware glitches.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented the audio PID purge under service reference TV-AUD-88192-I.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: TV-AUD-88192-I, recorded in my diary.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please give my warmest regards to your village film club and your chairman tonight, Valerie.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will tell all my neighbors what a wonderful technician Chloe from S-Net is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been our pleasure ensuring your cultural evening is a triumph.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can now bake the refreshments with complete peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just making sure our premises records match perfectly: that was 19 Queensgate, Inverness, wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 19 Queensgate, Inverness.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Valerie, all equipment and premises records are fully synchronized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you again Chloe for your wonderful, rapid, and reassuring support.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been an absolute pleasure assisting you, Valerie. Have a magnificent film screening tonight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have a wonderful afternoon, Chloe. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other TV or broadband issue I can assist you with today, Valerie?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Chloe, everything is working flawlessly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support, Valerie. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Chloe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
